sims.moon_phases: The Moon orbits the Earth: the half facing the Sun is always lit
sims.solar_eclipse: Solar eclipse: the Moon covers the Sun and its shadow falls on Earth
sims.lunar_eclipse: Lunar eclipse: the Moon enters Earth's shadow and turns red
sims.solar_system: Solar system: shortened periods, distances not to scale
sims.day_night: Day and night: Earth spins, one half always faces the Sun
sims.seasons: Autumn: the 23.5° axis tilt decides how much sunlight arrives
sims.gravity: Free fall: dropped together, an object takes longer to land on the Moon than on Earth or Jupiter. Faint balls mark equal time steps.
sims.tides: The Moon pulls the sea into a bulge toward it, and Earth spins beneath two bulges of water
sims.aurora: Aurora: the solar wind is steered to the poles by Earth's magnetic field, hits the atmosphere and glows
sims.blackhole_lens: Gravitational lens: starlight bends into an Einstein ring
